title: Which models does Perplexity Pro use

entries.query_str: just started the pro trial. which models can i pick and is there a limit
entries.answer: With Pro you can choose the model used for answers in **Settings → AI model** or per query from the model picker; options typically include Perplexity's own Sonar models plus several third-party frontier models (e.g., recent GPT, Claude and Gemini models) [1]. Pro Search ("Copilot"-style multi-step search) has a daily allowance that is much higher than on the free tier, and some reasoning/research modes have their own lower caps [1][2]. Your trial gives the same limits as paid Pro until it ends; you can cancel before renewal in account settings [2].
